title: THE FIRE IS A REAL FIRE IN THE WORLD
why: His standing order of 2026-10-14: the new raid features are more fun but janky next to the rest of the game, and must be polished to the same level. The fire hazard was a flat brown disc with a ring of orange triangles drawn on the screen, over walls, roofs and the fog. It is now drawn in the world, in the same sort as the walls and the bodies: a ragged scorch of soot (a burn mark the ground keeps), a heat glow, glowing coals, layered red, orange and yellow flame tongues that flicker and sway, smoke that climbs and drifts, rising sparks, and a light the bloom picks up. It smoulders while warned, catches with a burst of sparks and a puff, burns full, dies down to coals and the coals fade. Walls and bodies stand in front of it where they should and the fog covers it where you cannot see; a linked window draws the same fire. Only the edge stays on the screen, as a thin ring.
now: Fires are drawn as real fires on the ground now, with flames, smoke, sparks and a glow.
